raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Square domain side length",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies a square and its element count, but gives no physical side length or units. These readings preserve all relative lengths, including filter lengths.",
      "readings": [
        "Domain [0,1] × [0,1], with element width 1/64",
        "Domain [0,64] × [0,64], with element width 1"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional model in Secs. 2 and 4.1 has no stated thickness or unit-depth convention. A uniform thickness multiplies stiffness without changing the layout under prescribed forces.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t=1 in the chosen length units",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.01L, where L is the square side length",
        "Uniform thickness t=0.1L"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "All fixed supports for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 allows one to four fixed points or segments at specified boundary landmarks, but neither Sec. 5 nor the Fig. 3 caption identifies row 1's count, locations, or segment endpoints. Coordinates below use [0,L] × [0,L].",
      "readings": [
        "One fixed segment covering the entire left edge",
        "One fixed segment from (0,0) to (0,L/2)",
        "Two fixed points at (0,0) and (0,L)",
        "Three fixed points at (0,0), (0,L), and (L,0)",
        "Four fixed points, one at each corner"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Single external load for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 places the load somewhere on a domain edge, and Eq. 25 names its coordinates, but row 1's coordinates are not supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Right-edge midpoint: (L,L/2)",
        "Right edge at quarter height: (L,L/4)",
        "Top-edge midpoint: (L/2,L)",
        "Bottom-edge midpoint: (L/2,0)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial application and discretization of the single load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says a single unit load is applied 'along the edge'; the load coordinates in Sec. 4.2 do not establish its footprint or nodal distribution.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the entire unit resultant at one boundary node",
        "Represent a point force between two boundary nodes using linear nodal interpolation, preserving the unit resultant",
        "Apply uniform traction over an edge patch of length L/16 centered at the load coordinate, with unit resultant"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of the unit external load for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 says direction is randomly sampled; neither Sec. 5 nor the Fig. 3 caption supplies this instance's direction or force components.",
      "readings": [
        "(Fx,Fy)=(0,-1)",
        "(Fx,Fy)=(-1,0)",
        "(Fx,Fy)=(-1/sqrt(2),-1/sqrt(2))"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Prescribed volume fraction for Fig. 3, row 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 gives the sampling interval 0.3–0.5, but no row-specific target appears in Sec. 5 or the Fig. 3 caption.",
      "readings": [
        "f=0.30",
        "f=0.40",
        "f=0.50"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design elements, particularly near loads and supports",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2 and 4.1 do not explicitly identify passive solid or void masks, or establish that every element remains designable.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive regions; every element is designable",
        "Elements incident to the load application point are forced solid; all others are designable",
        "One element layer incident to supported boundaries and the load application region is forced solid; all remaining elements are designable"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid Young's modulus E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2, Eq. 2 introduces E0 symbolically, but no value is reported. These alternatives hold Emin/E0 and other dimensionless parameters fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "E0=1 in a nondimensional model",
        "E0=70 GPa",
        "E0=210 GPa"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The elastic formulation in Sec. 2 and dataset description in Sec. 4.1 give no Poisson's ratio.",
      "readings": [
        "nu=0.25",
        "nu=0.30",
        "nu=0.35"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional constitutive reduction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The paper calls the problem two-dimensional without specifying plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress",
        "Isotropic plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual void stiffness Emin/E0",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2, Eq. 2 requires a minimum modulus Emin, but neither its value nor its ratio to E0 is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Emin/E0=1e-9",
        "Emin/E0=1e-6",
        "Emin/E0=1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element interpolation and quadrature",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 4.1–4.2 determine the structured array of square elements, but not their displacement interpolation, node count, or integration rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2×2 Gauss integration",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration",
        "Nine-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3×3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Minimum permitted design density",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2, Eq. 9 introduces rho_min without assigning a value; the general bounds in Eq. 6 do not select it.",
      "readings": [
        "rho_min=0, using positive Emin to regularize void stiffness",
        "rho_min=1e-3",
        "rho_min=1e-2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filtering method and affected quantities",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the SIMP description in Sec. 2 nor dataset generation in Sec. 4.1 specifies whether filtering is used or how it enters the formulation.",
      "readings": [
        "No filtering",
        "Sensitivity filtering, with element densities used directly for stiffness and volume",
        "Density filtering, with filtered physical densities used for both stiffness and volume"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter radius",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If filtering is used, Secs. 2 and 4.1 give no radius or length convention. Here h denotes element width.",
      "readings": [
        "r=1.5h",
        "r=3h",
        "r=5h"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter kernel",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If filtering is used, its weighting kernel is not reported in Secs. 2 or 4.1.",
      "readings": [
        "Conical weights w=max(0,r-d), using Euclidean distance d between element centers",
        "Equal weights for element centers within Euclidean distance r",
        "Gaussian weights with standard deviation r/3, truncated at distance r"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If filtering is used, the text does not specify how a filter neighborhood extending outside the square is handled.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the neighborhood to in-domain elements and renormalize",
        "Extend outside the domain with zero density and retain those weights in the normalization",
        "Mirror the density field across domain boundaries"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density projection during optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 mentions final thresholding, but does not establish whether a smooth projection also acts during optimization or give its parameters.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection during optimization",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with beta=2 and projection threshold 0.5",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with threshold 0.5 and beta=1,2,4,8 over successive blocks of 25 iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Update parameters m and eta",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2, Eq. 10 specifies only that m and eta are positive; Sec. 4.1 supplies neither value for dataset generation.",
      "readings": [
        "Use Eq. 10 with m=1 and eta=0.5",
        "Use Eq. 10 with m=1 and eta=1",
        "Use Eq. 10 with m=0.5 and eta=0.25"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial optimization density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1's fully solid initial domain is specified for conditioning-field FEA, but the starting densities for the SIMP optimization itself are not stated.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density rho_e=f",
        "Uniform initial density rho_e=1",
        "A fixed-seed random perturbation about f, adjusted to satisfy the initial volume constraint"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Numerical solution for the volume multiplier lambda",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 says lambda is adjusted to enforce Eq. 11, but gives no search method or numerical tolerance.",
      "readings": [
        "Bisection until absolute volume-fraction residual is below 1e-8",
        "Bisection until absolute volume-fraction residual is below 1e-4",
        "Safeguarded Newton iteration until absolute volume-fraction residual is below 1e-8"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Finite-element equilibrium solver accuracy",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 requires KU=F, but the numerical solver and equilibrium tolerance used to generate the finite-iteration reference design are not reported.",
      "readings": [
        "Double-precision sparse direct solution",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-8",
        "Preconditioned conjugate gradients with relative residual tolerance 1e-4"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Conversion of optimized densities to the binary SIMP topology",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 mentions thresholding and Sec. 4.1 says samples contain binary topology maps, but neither gives the threshold or a volume-preserving binarization rule.",
      "readings": [
        "After optimization, mark elements solid when rho_e>=0.5",
        "After optimization, mark elements solid when rho_e>=0.3",
        "After optimization, retain the highest-density elements until the solid element count is nearest to f×4096"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
